Create Architectural Decision Record (ADR) for Domain Model specified in the prompt.
If the Domain Model is not specified, ask for clarification.

The ADR file should be placed in the 'wiki/domain' folder.

The file should have following structure:

# [ADR file number]. [Domain Model Name] explanation

Date: YYYY-MM-DD
Status: Proposed | Accepted | Deprecated

## Context

[Explain the context and background for the decision regarding the domain model. Include any relevant information about the problem being solved, the requirements, and any constraints.]
[For more details you can check features for specific domain model under 'Features/[DomainModelName]' folder.]
[In this section do not describe relations to other domain models.]

## Relationships

[Describe how this domain model relates to other domain models in the system. Include any associations, dependencies, or interactions that are relevant to understanding the domain model's role within the overall architecture.]
[For relations you can check Persistance/Configurations folder.]
